jobs.name: Daily Leads & Outreach Check
jobs.prompt:
Run the daily leads and outreach status check for Zion Tech Group. From /Users/miami2/zion.app/automation, execute: python3 scripts/cron_daily_leads_check.py

This script:
1. Scans Gmail inbox for new potential leads (via reseed_from_outreach.py)
2. Compiles fresh leads from all discovery sources (compile_leads.py merge)
3. Checks outreach send log for today's send/fail counts
4. Reads the growth engine report for current status
5. Writes reports/daily-leads-check-latest.json

Report the summary to the Zion Agents Telegram group.

jobs.name: Weekly Growth Progress Report
jobs.prompt:
Generate the weekly growth progress report for Zion Tech Group. From /Users/miami2/zion.app/automation, execute: python3 scripts/cron_weekly_growth_report.py

This script:
1. Aggregates leads from data/zion_leads_free.json (by priority and type)
2. Parses outreach-send-log.jsonl for 7-day and all-time stats
3. Reads growth-engine-report-latest.json for engine status
4. Reads ceo-status.json for site/deploy/CRM state
5. Reads cron-status-report.json for site coverage
6. Generates a Telegram-ready weekly summary
7. Writes reports/weekly-growth-progress-latest.json

Deliver the Telegram summary to the Zion Agents Telegram group.

jobs.name: Biweekly Content Calendar Refresh
jobs.prompt:
Run the biweekly content calendar refresh for Zion Tech Group. From /Users/miami2/zion.app/automation, execute: python3 scripts/cron_biweekly_content_calendar.py

This script:
1. Counts existing blog posts and extracts existing titles from /Users/miami2/zion.app/blog
2. Loads the previous blog content plan (if any)
3. Checks if a refresh is needed (calendar older than 14 days or new posts published)
4. Generates a 14-day content calendar with cluster-balanced topics
5. Identifies missing content clusters (gaps in coverage)
6. Writes reports/content-calendar-biweekly-latest.json

Deliver the Telegram summary to the Zion Agents Telegram group.
